decisive_items: Diffuse lymphadenopathy and a large mesenteric mass
response.rationale: Diffuse lymphadenopathy with a mesenteric mass encasing vasculature strongly favors lymphoma over sarcoma (which lacks diffuse nodal involvement) or panniculitis (inflammatory, not typically encasing vessels).

rejected.why: Sarcoma typically presents as a solitary mass without diffuse lymphadenopathy; the systemic nodal pattern is more consistent with lymphoma.
Mesenteric panniculitis is inflammatory and would not explain diffuse lymphadenopathy or vascular encasement; also lacks the neoplastic context.
